categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Matches Utils/log/libs label and modifies src/logging.cpp
categories.rationale: Prevents terminal control sequence injection via logs by escaping UTF-8 encoded C1 control codes. As the PR notes, LogEscapeMessage previously passed U+0080 through U+009F, allowing untrusted data to emit CSI, OSC, and DCS sequences that VTE-based terminals execute.
